subject: Carter Faith
title: Who is Carter Faith? Heartland actress and CMA new artist nominee
answer: Carter Faith is a country singer-songwriter from Davidson, North Carolina, signed to MCA Nashville. Her debut album, "Cherry Valley," came out on Oct. 3, 2025. She is nominated for New Artist of the Year at the CMA Awards on Nov. 18, 2026, and she co-stars in Netflix's thriller Heartland, out Nov. 13.
body:
Faith, born Carter Faith Jones in 2000, studied in Belmont University's songwriting program in Nashville and graduated in December 2021. She made her Grand Ole Opry debut in June 2022. Before her debut album she released the EPs "Let Love Be Love" (2021), "Man" (2023) and "The Aftermath" (2024). Singles include "Betty" and "That's When You Know," a 2026 collaboration with Kygo.

"Cherry Valley" was nominated for Album of the Year at the 61st Academy of Country Music Awards in 2026, making her the first artist in more than a decade to earn that nomination with a debut album. At the 2026 CMA Awards she is a first-time nominee, competing for New Artist of the Year with Avery Anna, Emily Ann Roberts, Tucker Wetmore and Stephen Wilson Jr.

In Netflix's Heartland she plays Charlie Heart, a rising country musician who goes missing; Jessica Chastain plays her aunt, a retired country star who searches for her.
in_the_news: Faith appears in Netflix's Heartland, out Nov. 13, 2026, and is a nominee at the CMA Awards on Nov. 18, 2026.
